ValidationRule.description: To prevent AM BR from changing Business Type on a quote which has quote lines.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRByPassToggle__c )), ISPICKVAL( PMC_CPQ_Region__c , 'Brazil'), SBQQ__LineItemCount__c > 0, ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_QuoteRecordSubType__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Delete the Product from Cart to make changes to business type or create a fresh quote for another business type.
